'''Radon-Ulzer''' was the manufacturer of the [[620C racing engine/Legends|620C racing engine]], the same engine used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|custom podracer]]. They also manufactured the [[1240C racing engine]], which Anakin used in his [[Anakin Skywalker's second Podracer|second custom podracer]].
